faqs.question: How do I know this is the right variant for my OmniBook 7 14-fs?
faqs.answer: The 14-fs series ships with two different panels: 3K OLED (this listing) and WUXGA IPS. Send us your full model number or a photo of the label under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm which one you need before you order.

faqs.question: Is it touch screen?
faqs.answer: No, this is a non-touch panel — the OmniBook 7 14-fs is a standard clamshell laptop, not a 2-in-1 convertible.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this screen?
faqs.answer: This screen carries a 3-month warranty against dead pixels and panel defects.
